# @aponiajs/mapped-types

> Mapped DTO utilities (`PartialType`, `PickType`, `OmitType`, `IntersectionType`) for AponiaJS validation models and plain DTO classes.

## Key exports

- `PartialType(BaseClass)`
- `PickType(BaseClass, keys)`
- `OmitType(BaseClass, keys)`
- `IntersectionType(ClassA, ClassB)`
